positions.title: Executive Assistant to the Shalikashvili Chair in National Security Studies
positions.description:
- Supported Admiral (retired) Jonathan Greenert, 30th Chief of Naval Operations for the U.S. Navy and holder of NBR’s Shalikashvili Chair in National Security Studies, with national security and U.S.-Asia relations programming at NBR
- Organized 2016 and 2018 maritime security conferences featuring senior naval officers from Japan, Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, and the U.S.; coordinated logistics with executive and defense officials from each country
- Collaborated with the media team to arrange and support interviews and press briefings for Admiral Greenert

projects.title: 2018 Energy Security Program - "The Emerging Russia-Asia Energy Axis"
projects.description:
The 2018 Energy Security Program “The Emerging Russia-Asia Energy Axis” examined how energy industry shifts in Russia are opening new avenues for Russia-Asia energy projects and investment, and assessed the energy security and strategic implications of Russia’s increasingly active energy pivot to Asia.

In charge of coordinating the report and spring workshop.

projects.title: 2017 Energy Security Program - "Asia's Energy Security and China's Belt and Road Initiative"​
projects.description:
• Energy Security Workshop (June 2017): http://www.nbr.org/research/activity.aspx?id=756
• Energy Security Report (November 2017): http://nbr.org/publications/issue.aspx?id=353
• Capitol Hill panel discussion (December 2017): http://www.nbr.org/research/activity.aspx?id=819

The 2017 Energy Security Program, "Asia's Energy Security and China's Belt and Road Initiative" will examine how China's ambitious plans to expand trade, investment, and diplomatic engagement across the Eurasian continent and through the sea lanes of the Indo-Pacific could reshape energy markets and assesses the implications for stakeholders in the region. The 2017 program convened a high-level workshop in the spring and will hold a public panel on the final report in the fall.

In charge of coordinating the final report, spring workshop, and Capitol Hill launch event.
